input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: new venture cvss-vector-check (CVSS v3.1/v3.0 scorer, diff, report audit)

errors.what: First v3.0 Roundup was a naive Math.ceil(x*10)/10; the oracle fixture caught 7 of 3,000 vectors disagreeing (5.0*0.92 -> 4.7). Fixed to the exact reading; naive kept as an audit explainer.
parseVector accepted AV:toString (prototype keys through `in`); platform/ci/inherited_keys.py flagged a related lookup during run_venture_tests. Fixed with Object.hasOwn/Map, test added.
First post description was 213 characters; check_post_frontmatter.py caught it before merge.
sibling-links-ci failed: the new tool had no sibling linking back. Added a link from npm-audit-triage's footer, with tests in both ventures.
check_csv_formula_guard.py (run inside ventures-tests) flagged auditCsv for escaping plain negative numbers; fixed to the repo's convention.

doc_friction.issue: Points to portfolio duplicate screening implicitly; the duplicate_check.py tool lives at portfolio/pipeline/, not portfolio/ledger/ beside supersede_check.py, which cost one lookup.
Finding past explore ideas meant grepping 8,000+ JSON records; a `promptctl.py ideas --track explore` listing of notes would save time.

checklist-coverage.yml is red on main: PR #16739 added platform/ci/venture-yaml-readers.test.mjs and the checklist does not name `node --test platform/ci/*.test.mjs`. The fix is in /.github/ (CODEOWNERS, owner-gated), so it was left out of this PR.

--for-changes hands long workflows off to a detached process, and any later edit voids them. Committing a fix during the run made me rerun three workflows; with --foreground from the start this would have been avoided.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run': a CVSS scorer is calculator-shaped. Did it anyway because the depth is the audit of whole reports, the vector diff and exact rounding that chatbots get wrong; measured with an exhaustive oracle check.
deviations.did: Built scorer + diff + report audit + CLI with --strict, with a measured guide page
deviations.result: Merged with 33 tests; the measurement produced a publishable finding (3.0 and 3.1 base scores identical over the whole space)

notes: Explore idea: CVSS v3 vector checker (no venture covered CVSS). Engine differential-tested against Red Hat's cvss PyPI 3.6: 0 differences on all 259,200 base+temporal vectors per version and 200,000 random environmental vectors. Findings: base/temporal identical across 3.0 and 3.1; environmental differ by 0.1 only with Changed modified scope (6.3% of uniform sample, 0.3% change band); naive 3.0 ceiling wrong on 228 temporal scores. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README holds everything a next run needs. Next: CVSS 4.0. Local checks: run_venture_tests cvss-vector-check 33/33; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, check_md_links ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output summarised in the PR. Local CI on the final tree: sibling-links 2/2, ventures-tests 5/5, portfolio-validate 100/100, and conflict-markers, distribution-versions, doc-refs, duplicate-symbols, link-contrast, readme-live-links, page-integrity, agent-permission-harness, pages, control-plane-guard all pass (uses:/secret steps not run). checklist-coverage fails on main for an unrelated reason (doc_friction).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
